verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents an official Model Context Protocol server, confirmed by a probe of the using-agents page, so an agent can connect to it. Its stated scope is limited to letting agents search and retrieve documentation content, not to operating the MoonPay platform. missing for 10: MCP tools for platform operations (quotes, transactions, customers, webhooks), setup/auth details for the MCP server, independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.
